Malformation of lymphatic vessels; no consistent additional organ damage across anatomical sites.

Skeletal dysplasia; gingival overgrowth 3/3 and dental abnormalities 1/2; bicuspid aortic valve and developmental delay each 1/3. Estimates derive from a very small cohort.

Inherited glomerular disease with steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome in 7/7 and glomerulosclerosis in 5/5 patients.

Cystic transformation affects pancreatic acinar tissue, the exocrine pancreas; endocrine involvement is not established.

Congenital abnormal arterial-to-venous communication; anatomical distribution varies, without established common injury to another organ.

Centrofacial lentiginosis with neurodysraphic neurodevelopmental abnormalities; supplied phenotypes support skin disease and intellectual disability.

GI dysmotility and dysphagia occur in 30–79%; joint laxity and flat feet lack documented functional injury; developmental incontinence does not establish urinary organ damage.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in the pancreas; pancreatic location, hematologic lineage and lymphoma mechanism all apply.
Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy defines metabolic, brain and skeletal muscle disease; marrow hypocellularity and aminoaciduria are occasional, below 30%.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain disorder; hepatomegaly and elevated ALT/AST in 1/1 reported patient support hepatic injury, although the cohort is extremely small.
